name: swift-protobuf
description: Plugin and runtime library for using protobuf with Swift

issues.title: Linking against static library that uses SwiftProtobuf causes linker errors
Support deprecated annotation on messages, fields, enums, enum values.
Current use of serializedDataSize() in serializedData() causes additional runtime linear in the depth of the proto hierarchy
_StorageClass makes large arrays of non-trivial messages impractical.
Provide something for parsing a binary stream of protobuf data

latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
### SemVer Minor
* reject duplicate singular fields in TextFormat by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/pull/2213
* Version bump for a relase by @thomasvl in https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/pull/2239
### SemVer Patch
* Reconstruct descriptor protos on demand in extractProto() by @thomasvl in https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/pull/2233
* Fix Any depth budget CoW handling and WKT contentJSON textTraverse limit by @thomasvl in https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/pull/2237
* Accept JSON Timestamp offsets up to ±23:59 by @0z5a in https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/pull/2236
### Other Changes
* Move `assertDebugDescription` usages to `assertDebugDescriptionSuffix` by @thomasvl in https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/pull/2238

## New Contributors
* @mvanhorn made their first contribution in https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/pull/2213
* @0z5a made their first contribution in https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/pull/2236

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apple/swift-protobuf/compare/1.40.0...1.41.0
